description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to specific colors used in a dashboard interface. It includes functions for deterministic color generation from arbitrary strings and mapping various status labels to theme-specific colors, designed for consistent display on dark backgrounds.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel HSL color from an input string, ensuring distinct hues for different strings while maintaining suitable saturation and lightness for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps known status strings to specific theme colors; if the status is unknown, produces a deterministic color based on the string, with special handling for common statuses like 'processing', 'success', 'failed', and 'unknown'.
